headline: PetroChina Q3 Net Profit Rises 21.6% to $7.78 Billion
summary: PetroChina reported a third-quarter net profit of 51.84 billion yuan ($7.78 billion), up 21.6% from a year earlier, supported by higher oil and gas prices.
why: PetroChina is Asia's largest oil and gas producer, playing a vital role in regional and global energy markets.

impacts.name: PetroChina
impacts.why: Strong profit growth enhances the company's financial performance metrics.

why_moved: Significant profit expansion above prior-year figures signals robust operational results during a period of high commodity prices.
